title: Te Moenga o te Hunga Tika
intro: I te wā i mōrearea ai te whakapono, ā, i rapu te hunga whai mana ki te whakangaro i te whakapono, i whiriwhiria e tētahi rōpū taitamariki he kōwhiringa ka pāorooro tonu i roto i ngā tau. I te oma atu i ngā mea katoa i mōhiotia e rātou, ka rapu piringa rātou i roto i te pōuri huna o te maunga, ā, ka whakawhirinaki katoa ki a Allah. Ko te mea i tupu i muri mai ka waiho hei tohu pumau mō te hunga e whakaaroaro ana.
clues: He rōpū taitamariki mātou i whakapono ki tō mātou Ariki, ā, i whakanuia e ia tō mātou arataki.
I tū mātou i mua i tō mātou iwi, ā, i kī mātou e kore rawa mātou e karanga ki tētahi atu atua i tua atu i a Allah.
I rapu piringa mātou i roto i tētahi ana, me te kī atu, 'E tō mātou Ariki, homai he aroha ki a mātou, ā, arahina mātou i roto i te tika o tā mātou mahi.'
He maha ngā tau i moe ai mātou, ā, ka anga atu te rā i tō mātou ana, ā, kāore e pā mai ki a mātou.
I takoto ta mātou kurī i te kuwaha o te ana, e tiaki ana i a mātou me te mea kei te tūtaki.
I tō mātou oho ake, ka miharo mātou kia pēhea te roa o tō mātou noho, ā, ka tonoa mai tētahi o mātou me ngā moni hiriwa hei hoko kai.

arabic: وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِى كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَـٰثَ مِا۟ئَةٍۢ سِنِينَ وَٱزْدَادُوا۟ تِسْعًۭا
verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (18:25)
